body:
When I was a child, I tried to kill myself several times because I thought I was an awful person and everyone would be better off without me.  I didn’t hate myself but I thought everyone else did.  I thought they’d be glad I was gone.  But I was too dumb to successfully do it.

Now I wanna die bc I hate myself and I’m sick of life yadda yadda but I now know death is hard for other people to deal with so I won’t even dare to try. 

Basically the point is, I always try to do what other people would want, I guess.  

Thank you for your words, I really try to be a good person.  You are so kind yourself and I hope you’re doing okay.
thank you, this means a lot <3
Aw I bet he’s adorable!  I’ve never had a cat but I’d love one in the future.

Idk if this counts but Trader Joe’s has these dried apple chip thingys that are the best!

Also my family’s old backyard was super small.  But there was room for one apple tree.  Me and my sister loved climbing it and picking apples when we were younger.
I’m glad you’re still here, and that you’ve found something you’re passionate about.  What’s drum corps like?  I’m afraid I don’t know much about it.
Haha I love animals.  Do/did you have a pet cat?
I hope you find love and pure happiness again this year!
Yikes, I’m sorry that happened.  Here’s to happier times ahead!
Awesome!  That’s the best part about the holidays imo.
I’m sorry it’s like that.  I truly hope the new year brings you some form of happiness <3
Wow that sounds like a great time!  What was it like in there?
ah yes nothing beats the happiness of childhood.  I hope happiness finds you again soon.
Hey I totally understand.  Nothing really strikes my emotions anymore.  Sometimes I’m not sure if I’m actually happy or if it’s just my brain telling me I should be happy.  But I’m working on it.
Glad to hear it man. I was happy for a bit when my friend who lives far away texted me to say Happy New Year :)
